units.source_text: 河童宝宝有本事做出这样的回复。

en.t: Kappa babies are capable of giving replies like this.

units.source_text: 刚生下来，自然就会走路说话。

en.t: As soon as they are born, they can naturally walk and talk.

units.source_text: 听查喀说，有个宝宝出生二十六天

en.t: According to Chack, one baby, twenty-six days after birth,

units.source_text: 就做了一个关于是否有神存在的演讲。

en.t: gave a lecture on whether God exists.

units.source_text: 遗憾的是，这个孩子第二月就夭折了。

en.t: Unfortunately, this child died young in its second month.

units.source_text: 说到分娩，我顺便提一句，

en.t: Speaking of childbirth, let me mention in passing,

units.source_text: 来到河童国第三个月的某一天，我偶然在街道上看到一大张海报。

en.t: one day in my third month after arriving in the land of the kappa, I happened to see a large poster on the street.

units.source_text: 海报下半部分画着十二三只河童——其中有的吹号，有的执剑。

en.t: The lower half of the poster showed a dozen or so kappa, some blowing horns and some holding swords.

units.source_text: 上半部分是写着密密麻麻的河童文字——就像时钟发条般的螺旋文字。

en.t: The upper half was covered with dense kappa writing, spiral letters like the mainspring of a clock.

units.source_text: 翻译后的大概意思就是（可能有点小错误，

en.t: In rough translation, the meaning was as follows, though there may be a few small errors,

units.source_text: 但是我是根据与我同行的河童学生拉卟朗诵出来的话，

en.t: because I based it on what the kappa student Lapp, who was accompanying me, read aloud,
and recorded it piece by piece in my notebook:
